mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.name AS userName, u.phone, r.role_name AS roleName, IFNULL(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS totalAmount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM passes pass WHERE pass.user_id = u.user_id ) AS totalCouponCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM passes pass WHERE pass.user_id = u.user_id AND pass.used = FALSE ) AS availableCouponCount, c.course_id AS courseId, c.title, c.description, c.course_date AS courseDate, c.course_start_time AS courseStartTime, c.course_end_time AS courseEndTime, c.category, c.course_room AS courseRoom, c.created_at AS courseCreatedAt, c.updated_at AS courseUpdatedAt, c.trainer_id AS trainerId, tu.name AS trainerName FROM users u JOIN roles r ON u.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN participations pa ON u.user_id = pa.user_id LEFT JOIN courses c ON pa.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN trainer_profiles tp ON c.trainer_id = tp.trainer_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tp.user_id = tu.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, c.course_id
